title: Ginseng Promotes White Adipose Tissue Browning: A Network of Thermogenic Pathways and Gut Microbiota Modulation.
abstract: Obesity is characterized by abnormal adipose tissue expansion and energy metabolism imbalance. Browning of white adipose tissue (WAT), wherein white adipocytes acquire thermogenic properties similar to brown adipose tissue, represents a key mechanism for increasing energy expenditure.
